seo.meta_title: How Many Mellow Mushroom Locations Are There? (2026)
seo.meta_description: Mellow Mushroom has about 160 restaurants, mostly in the Southeast, led by Georgia, Florida and North Carolina. Where it is, its history and who owns it.
seo.h1: Mellow Mushroom Locations: How Many and Where

question: How Many Mellow Mushroom Locations Are There?
quick_answer: Mellow Mushroom has about 160 restaurants across roughly 16 to 18 states, mostly in the Southeast. Georgia has the most, about 45 locations, followed by Florida and North Carolina. The pizza chain was founded in Atlanta in 1974, is still based there, and every restaurant is a locally owned franchise. Use the location finder on Mellow Mushroom's website to find the closest one.
key_facts: Roughly 16 to 18 states, mostly in the Southeast

body.heading: Where Mellow Mushroom is
body.text: Mellow Mushroom is a Southern pizza chain at heart. A November 2025 count found 163 U.S. locations in 16 states, with the biggest clusters in Georgia, Florida and North Carolina. Those three states hold more than half of all locations, and Virginia, Alabama, Tennessee and South Carolina also have a good number. Coverage is thin in the West and Midwest, with only a few restaurants in states like Colorado, Indiana and Texas.

body.heading: How many locations it has
body.text: Counts vary a little by source and date, but most recent figures put Mellow Mushroom at about 160 restaurants. The company itself describes 160-plus locally owned franchise locations across 18-plus states. That's down slightly from about 170 in 2021, as some restaurants have closed while new ones open.

body.heading: Mellow Mushroom's history
body.text: Three recent college graduates opened the first Mellow Mushroom near Georgia Tech in Atlanta in 1974. The chain started franchising in 1987. It's known for its stone-baked pizzas, psychedelic artwork and laid-back, counterculture vibe, and many locations host trivia nights or live music. Popular pizzas include the Holy Shiitake Pie and Kosmic Karma.

body.heading: Who owns Mellow Mushroom
body.text: Mellow Mushroom is a private company. Its parent is Home Grown Industries of Georgia, based in Atlanta, and each restaurant is owned and run by a local franchisee, which is why decor and some menu items vary between locations. In late 2024 the chain opened its first counter-service location, a newer format it plans to grow.

body.heading: Finding one near you
body.text: The easiest way to find the closest restaurant is the location finder on Mellow Mushroom's website or app, which shows hours and online ordering. For menu prices, see our Mellow Mushroom menu page.

faqs.q: How many Mellow Mushroom locations are there?
faqs.a: About 160 in the U.S. as of late 2025 and 2026.

faqs.a: In Atlanta, Georgia, near Georgia Tech, in 1974.
